ns2:section.sectionText: Assuming that we have launched astronauts to the Martian surface and they will stay there for a significant amount of time, the astronauts will conduct significant scientific activity. To do this they will need a number of supporting systems. The surface transportation systems project will specify a fleet of vehicles for use in exploring the Martian surface and conducting scientific research. They will necessarily include both robotic exploration vehicles and astronaut transportation vehicles. This project will outline the system-of-system needed and explore one or more of those concepts in higher detail.
